**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (no redline).**

The Agreement contains no auto-renewal mechanic at all:

- **§ 2 Term (p0011):** evergreen term from the date hereof "until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6" — no renewal terms, no successive periods, no notice-window mechanic.
- **§ 6(a) (p0032):** mutual termination "for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice" whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding — an exit shorter than the preferred 30-day opt-out.
- **§ 1(a) (p0004):** further engagement only through Statements of Work "executed by the parties," so continuation of work is by mutual written agreement.

Because renewal is not automatic, the conditional preferred elements (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day Vendor reminder) and the renewal price-uplift cap are not engaged, and there is no non-renewal window to shorten. This sits at (indeed above) the preferred position, so no redline.

One item noted for the pricing rule rather than double-flagged here: § 3(b) (p0014) lets Contractor "change rates with 30 days notice" with no cap — an uncapped mid-term price change, not a renewal uplift. Worth capping under the pricing/fees rule if that rule is in scope for this review.
